metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. The two readers are analysis-only, fit on Y's exact fixed 256-transition subset, tuned on Y's canonical VAL, evaluated once on Y's untouched canonical TEST. Selection is VAL-only; best-on-TRAIN is diagnostic; TEST is never used to select a condition/reader/history. The three conditions (adam_ref/adamw/adam_xavier) reuse AB's exact optimizer/initialization implementations; the ADAM_REF condition at 5,000 updates must reproduce Y's stored 1,000-update record.

trainer_identity.note: fresh re-run of Y's own trainer under AC's identical seed/data/optimizer/init; must be exact

stored_bridge.note: AC adam_ref vs Y's STORED JSON; cross-environment numerical drift (amplified on sensitive cells), not a protocol mismatch; reported explicitly and never gating

primary_decision.rule_note: AC-INVALID if preflight/invariant/protocol fails, the adam_ref GRU control is not robust at both histories, or adam_ref does not reproduce Y's stored 1,000-update trajectory; else AC-A if some QUALIFIED recipe (adamw, adam_xavier) is robust at BOTH histories; else AC-MIX if a qualified recipe is robust at exactly one history or reaches mean>=0.90 without the 4/5-seed criterion; else AC-B. Robust = five-seed mean max-train >=0.90 AND >=4/5 seeds >=0.90. adam_ref is reported separately.

generalization.rule_note: Generalization is reported SEPARATELY from fitting. For each qualified recipe at its best-on-VAL state: fit_without_generalization if Class-A<=0.25 AND held-out<=0.25; material_transfer if Class-A>=0.50 AND held-out>=0.30; else partial_transfer. A fit without meaningful transfer is NOT arithmetic recovery.
